title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Restoring Shortwave Radio) Bill 2017
short_title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Restoring Shortwave Radio) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) to restore and operate shortwave radio services for domestic listeners and audiences in Papua New Guinea and the Pacific.
It would require at least three domestic services across the Northern Territory and an international service using at least three transmitters to broadcast ABC programming.
The international service would have to use relevant local languages, and the new broadcasting obligations would begin on the day after Royal Assent.
changes: Domestic shortwave services would carry the nearby local radio service.
The ABC would be required to operate the domestic services that ceased on 31 January 2017.
International shortwave coverage would be mandated for Papua New Guinea and parts of the Pacific.
summary.affected: The ABC, rural and remote listeners, and audiences in Papua New Guinea and parts of the Pacific are affected.
